MATHEMATICS — MOCK EXAM #16
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x
   B. 12x + 2
   C. 6x + 2
   D. 12x

2. What is √64? (1 mark)
   A. 64
   B. 8
   C. 32
   D. 9

3. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 6 cm and 8 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 10
   C. 14
   D. 2

4. In the number 3143, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 4
   C. 40
   D. 400

5. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 25

6. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 100 000 m²
   B. 10 000 m²
   C. 100 m²
   D. 1000 m²

7. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 42
   C. 36
   D. 24

8. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31
   B. 37
   C. 31.7
   D. 31.6

9. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 31
   D. 1

10. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 1

11. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 82
   C. 81
   D. 9

12. In the number 3543, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 4
   C. 10
   D. 40

13. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 49
   D. 1

14. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 43
   C. 1
   D. 2

15. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 2/3
   B. 3/4
   C. 1/2
   D. 1/4

16. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 121
   B. 122
   C. 11
   D. 22

17. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27
   B. 27.7
   C. 27.6
   D. 33

18. What is 8 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 33
   C. 12
   D. 32

19. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. They are equal
   B. 1/4
   C. 1/2
   D. Cannot tell

20. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 5 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 30
   C. 75
   D. 20

21. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 26
   B. 5
   C. 10
   D. 25

22. What is 4 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 7
   C. 12
   D. 13

23. What is 4 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 33
   B. 32
   C. 12
   D. 4

24. Solve for x: x + 5 = 17. (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 17
   C. 13
   D. 12

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
25. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

26. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

30. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

31. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

32. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
